software.model_backend: upstream Transformers Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; do not use the custom PrimeRL VLM wrapper for this smoke

data.purpose: Use already preserved coordinator-action examples only to test forward/backward connectivity; do not interpret this as training or held-out capability evidence.

shared_input_path.feature_source: same coordinator prompt, never another node
shared_input_path.capture: last eight visible final text hidden states, detached
shared_input_path.injection: eight soft embeddings immediately before the verified assistant-generation opening
shared_input_path.embedding_shell: mean L2 norm of frozen e33 input embeddings, computed once and recorded

BASE.path: ordinary frozen e33 teacher-forced evaluation; no latent positions

STATIC.path: LocalDepthCodec task anchor decoded directly; no sidecar

RECURRENT.path: LocalDepthCodec plus one 10562048-parameter TimestepFreeRecurrentSidecar shared for exactly four steps
RECURRENT.bptt: one diagnostic backward pass through all four smoke steps; no optimizer step

matched_conditions.precision: bfloat16 model/activations; float32 diagnostic gradient summaries
matched_conditions.prompt_features: cache in host RAM only and reuse bitwise across arms
matched_conditions.loss: teacher-forced next-token cross-entropy on accepted coordinator action targets only

preflight_gates: Refuse unless the exact committed A0C binding and sidecar validate one immutable four-of-four carrier-only SUCCESS receipt with file SHA d88dd97e... and internal canonical SHA 40dde68d...; binding files remain outside the fresh terminal output namespace.

Refuse if the exact implementation ancestry, clean execution commit, plan hash, selection hash, source dataset hashes, model path, model revision, model hash, metadata hashes, execution environment, model backend, Transformers version/source hashes, or Torch version differs.
Refuse if host free disk is below 60 GiB or projected new artifacts exceed 512 MiB.
Refuse if H176 or any specialist checkpoint is loaded.
Refuse unless every e33 parameter has requires_grad=false and no optimizer is constructed.
Use the bound A0C bitwise hard-bypass receipt as the shared standard-path equivalence proof; do not import rejected A0R cache evidence or replace bitwise equality with argmax/tolerance.

Before importing the model class or entering a CUDA-facing path, strictly decode only the single final assistant target's function.arguments JSON string; require exactly one select_cognitive_action call whose decoded object is exactly {action: row.action}; reject malformed, duplicate-key, non-finite, non-object, extra-key, wrong-action, already-mapped, or multi-call targets.

Before model load, prove on all 12 exact rows that the raw source is unchanged, the sole modified path ends .function.arguments, restoring that path gives deep equality with the source, and nonempty reasoning_content is preserved byte-exact with its SHA-256 recorded.

Render plain, assistant-generation opening, and full target with explicit enable_thinking=true. Require exact string and token prefix relations full > opening > plain; do not use a longest-common-prefix boundary, disable thinking, delete/rewrite reasoning_content, or weaken either prefix predicate.

Verify the assistant-opening injection index against the live tokenizer/template, insert immediately before that opening, mask labels through the full explicit-thinking opening, and record tokenizer, template, rendered-string, and token-ID SHA-256 values before any model load or backward probe.
Verify exactly eight inserted positions, attention-mask ones, sequential position IDs, and -100 labels.
Verify STATIC, FFN, and RECURRENT share bitwise-identical initial LocalDepthCodec weights.
Verify FFN and RECURRENT total trainable parameter counts differ by exactly 107 parameters.
Verify zero-initialized FFN and RECURRENT visible outputs equal the STATIC task anchor exactly.
Hash every parameter tensor for e33, LocalDepthCodec, FFN, and RECURRENT before the first forward and after the last backward; every pre/post hash must match.

Serialize zero-dimensional state-dict tensors for hashing by reshaping the contiguous CPU tensor to one dimension before view(uint8), while hashing the original name, dtype, and shape exactly as before. Do not alter tensor values, numerical paths, or the separately scoped non-scalar tensor-byte helper.

Run the complete 12-row BASE/STATIC/FFN/RECURRENT forward-metric phase under torch.no_grad, require every metric loss to have requires_grad=false, convert each metric to a detached Python value, and release each model output before the next arm.

Keep the separately frozen single-row canonical and hypothetical-open-gate backward probes outside the no-grad region and gradient-enabled; do not checkpoint, offload, shrink rows or sequences, or alter any numerical arm call.
connectivity_requirements: All four arms produce finite teacher-forced loss on all 12 probe rows.
STATIC has finite nonzero diagnostic gradients in both codec projections on the frozen backward-probe row.
FFN and RECURRENT output-scale diagnostic gradients are finite and nonzero on the frozen backward-probe row.
At exact-zero sidecar output scale, FFN hidden/output and RECURRENT transition/memory/workspace diagnostic gradients are expected to be zero.

A second hypothetical open-gate diagnostic on the same row passes residual_scale_override=0.001 as a call argument without changing or persisting any parameter; it must produce finite nonzero gradients in FFN hidden/output and RECURRENT transition/memory/workspace projections.
The hypothetical open-gate diagnostic is reported separately and is never described as canonical-state behavior.
FFN and RECURRENT visible workspaces equal STATIC exactly on every probe row.
RECURRENT private memory changes at every one of the four steps on at least one row.
RECURRENT visible/private state diagnostics contain no non-finite values; change norms, contraction ratios, and direction cosines are recorded for every row.
No parameter changes in memory or on disk; e33 rehashes exactly after the smoke.
No arm is required to beat another in this connectivity smoke. Any capability or local-depth claim requires a later independently frozen evaluation.

allowed: per-arm forward losses and diagnostic gradient summaries
exactly one atomic SUCCESS.json or FAILURE.json receipt

host_schedule.gpu_0: Run the 12-row BASE, STATIC, FFN, and RECURRENT forward metrics sequentially without gradients; retain e33 activations only for one active arm at a time in the later canonical and hypothetical-open-gate backward probes.
host_schedule.gpu_1: remain idle; a second model placement is unnecessary for this same-node no-update probe

arguments: root-authorized exact SHA-256 of this plan file
launch_surface.outer_timeout: GNU timeout sends TERM at 120 minutes and KILL 30 seconds later
launch_surface.inner_timeout: Python stops compute at 114 minutes, reserves 5 minutes for failure hashes, and leaves 1 minute for terminal receipt publication
launch_surface.gpu_visibility: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1; runner uses cuda:0 sequentially and leaves cuda:1 idle
launch_surface.pre_output_checks: clean exact commit, root-authorized repair4-plan file hash, complete repair4 freeze-manifest hashes, exact initial failure, B-R preflight rejection, B-R2 scalar-hash failure, and B-R3 OOM bindings/artifacts, absent fresh output namespace; --preflight-only repeats all 12 tokenizer proofs without creating output
launch_surface.owner_authorization: Supplying the prospectively reviewed plan file SHA as the second argument is required but does not replace root's explicit scheduling decision.

stop_conditions: any optimizer is constructed or any parameter value changes
any non-finite loss, state, parameter, or gradient
both SUCCESS.json and FAILURE.json exist or either receipt is overwritten/non-atomically published
interpretation_boundary: This prospective repair4 changes only autograd and object lifetime during the unchanged 12-row forward-metric sweep: torch.no_grad covers BASE/STATIC/FFN/RECURRENT metric calculations, loss values are detached scalars, and each model output plus row-local sidecar tensors is released before later work. The separate canonical and hypothetical-open-gate single-row backward probes remain gradient-enabled and unchanged. The repair does not change tensor values, model/sidecar arithmetic, arms, rows, sequences, hashes, tokenizer behavior, or connectivity predicates, and it uses no checkpointing or offload. The zero-update fixed-depth smoke establishes only whether the self-local codec and bounded timestep-free recurrent path execute, preserve the standard no-op surface, evolve private memory, and expose the expected first-order gate gradients. It does not establish trainability behind the closed gate, test C2C/workspace handoff, specialist competence, end-to-end delegation, adaptive depth, halting, corruption curricula, or matched-parameter capability gain.
authorization: A0C-bound B-R4 frozen plan only. Independent gatekeeper review and an explicit root schedule are still required; this document does not authorize SSH, GPU/model execution, optimizer updates, publication, A0/A1 reinterpretation, or cache/generation claims. All prior run namespaces/evidence sets are immutable and must never be reused.
